scope: Clarification before any fresh time-wave physical run; original frozen recipe/seed/build artifacts retained unchanged
actual_initialization: JSph::RunInitialize can call FixedDt->GetDt(TimeStep,dtini) before the first DtVariable. Therefore cumulative dterror may include older initialization history; it is not solely a new complete-bound measurement.
fixture_implementation: Execute captures ExpectedFixedError=FixedDt->GetDtError(false) after InitRunCpu and before the first actual step. Each audited DtVariable then checks max(captured_initial_error, all used_dt-complete_bound so far). No reset and no additional GetDt call occurs.
telemetry_claim: PolicyGuard proves the new force-stage calls receive the complete bound, while preserving actual accumulated initialization telemetry. This is a private fixture diagnostic, not a repair of historical JSph::RunInitialize behavior or a whole-Run telemetry reinterpretation.
